# Elzinga Creative Studio

> Real estate photography, video, and digital marketing studio based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, serving West Michigan (Kent, Ottawa, and Allegan Counties). Owner-operated by Kaden Elzinga, FAA Part 107 certified for commercial drone work. Real estate listing packages: Essential $245 / Showcase $325 / Signature $495, every package delivered in 24 hours. Phone (616) 258-4578, email kaden@elzingacreativestudio.com.

## Key Facts

- Real estate listing packages: Essential $245, Showcase $325 (most popular), Signature $495
- 24-hour turnaround on every real estate photography package, delivered via Pixieset
- Service area: Grand Rapids and 25+ West Michigan cities across Kent, Ottawa, Allegan, and Barry Counties, no travel fee within ~25 miles of downtown Grand Rapids
- Real twilight (blue-hour) shoots: $150 add-on, or included free with Showcase and Signature. Real shoots, not virtual Photoshop skies
- FAA Part 107 certified for commercial drone photography; aerial is built into Signature, a $125 add-on on Essential and Showcase
- Brand Day Starter: $2,500 flat productized brand-content day for service businesses and coaches
- Content retainers from $350/mo (Starter) to $650/mo (Growth)
- $50 referral credit per referred-and-booked client, no cap, stackable
- Free Listing Photo Audit for West Michigan realtors: 5-minute video critique, 48-hour delivery, no commitment
- Notable past clients: Grand Rapids Griffins (AHL), Biggby Coffee, Mars Hill Church

## Common Questions

### How much does real estate photography cost in Grand Rapids?
Real estate photography in Grand Rapids generally ranges $150-$700 per listing. Elzinga Creative Studio uses three tiers: Essential $245 (25-35 HDR images), Showcase $325 (adds real twilight, floor plan, and social cuts), and Signature $495 (adds drone aerial, a 60-second Reel, and golden hour). Real twilight is a $150 add-on or included free with Showcase and Signature. Every package is delivered in 24 hours.

### Is real twilight better than virtual twilight?
Yes. Real twilight is a separate shoot at the actual blue hour with interior lights warm, exterior lit, and a true blue sky. Virtual twilight is a daytime photo with a fake sky added in Photoshop. Real twilight listings consistently outperform daytime-only photos on online views, and buyers can tell the difference.

### Do I need a Part 107 certified drone pilot for real estate photography?
Yes. If money is changing hands for the photography, FAA regulations require a Part 107 certified pilot. Hobbyist drone use does not extend to commercial real estate marketing. Elzinga Creative Studio operates Part 107 compliant on every commercial flight.

### What is the Preferred Photographer Program?
A standing photography partnership for West Michigan real estate agents: the same three listing tiers (Essential $245 / Showcase $325 / Signature $495), priority calendar access, a $50 referral credit per agent you refer in, and House Photographer status after your second paid shoot. No contract, no minimums.
